evidence: RenderMeshBounds::from_positions uses f32::min/max for each coordinate; rustc 1.94.1 probe gives 1.0_f32.min(f32::NAN) == 1.0 and max == 1.0. MeshAsset::validate in asset/assets/mesh/mesh_asset.rs:236-269 checks attribute formats, lengths, indices, topology but not finite position values; try_render_mesh_descriptor at :376-379 then calls from_positions.
impact: A mesh containing a NaN vertex can pass asset validation and produce a finite bounds descriptor that silently excludes malformed input, allowing downstream visibility/resource decisions to treat it as valid.
impact_or_question: A mesh containing a NaN vertex can pass asset validation and produce a finite bounds descriptor that silently excludes malformed input, allowing downstream visibility/resource decisions to treat it as valid.
next_action: Reject non-finite vertex positions in MeshAsset and model primitive validation, or return an explicit invalid-bounds result from construction; add a NaN regression covering descriptor and scene admission.
